Mon: double tonight (Josh). The POLP back squat is class part A, done first (the gym puts the main strength piece before the WOD on purpose); WOD at 60–70% with bike for the runs, wall balls optional; WL then swaps its back squat for the accessory (front rack support + monkeyfoot knee raises).

Wed: PM double instead of 5:30am WL (Josh). POLP deadlift as class part A, step-ups steady at 60–70%, then 6:30 WL: clean & jerk, the deadlift accessory (bent knee hip extensions + Pendlay rows) and POLP press. 2 POLP lifts (DL + press), no bench.

Front squat extras: zombie FS cut this week (Wed is full and squat extras are first on the cut list); Spanish squat holds 3 × 30 s stay, at home is fine. Step-ups cover single-leg work.
Thu as written. Bench is Phase 2 now: builds 72 × 5, 83 × 3, then 94 × 3 × 5 (workbook wk7).

Sun: Long Hard Night rehearsal (season plan): strict HSPU EMOM 8 min × 3 (kept, Josh: plenty of recovery from Tuesday) + ring MU drills, then 75–90 min of 20-min shifts.
Endurance track skipped (you're on Row W1, not the class's W9).

streams.label: Performance PM (5:30pm) — POLP back squat, then WOD at 60–70%
streams.text:
A. POLP Back Squat:
*First week 3s x 10r x 65%, add 5% for every successful week. If you fail the 10s twice chat to a coach.

B. 15 min AMRAP:
400m Run
20 Wall Balls (10/9ft, 30/20lbs)
100m Farmers Carry (32/24kg)

*If the legs are feeling it, feel free to skip the Wall Balls in today's WOD. Focus on smooth and fast runs and do your best on the Farmers.

→ A is your POLP back squat (wk8 row): two builds, then 144 × 3 × 5. B at 60–70%: bike ~1 km for each 400 m run. Wall balls optional.

streams.label: Long Hard Night rehearsal + HSPU EMOM + ring MU drills
streams.text:
1. Shoulder warm-up + 2 × 20 s wall-facing handstand hold

2. Strict HSPU EMOM 8 min × 3 reps (24 reps). Stop the EMOM as soon as a rep slows. No grinders, no kipping.

3. Ring muscle-up drills (~15 min), fresh:
- Kip swings on rings: 3 × 6. Tight hollow/arch, feet stay under you.
- False-grip kip to hips: 3 × 3. Pull the rings back to your hips, no turnover.
- Low-ring transitions: 3 × 5

4. 75–90 min as relay-style shifts, 20 min per machine:
- Row W1 S2: Row 30 min @ Z1 building to Z3 through the 30 min. HR: start under 128, finish 145–152.
- Ski 20 min, HR 130–140 (cap 144)
- Bike 20 min, HR 130–140 (cap 144)
- (Row or ski another 20 min if it's going well)

→ Eat and drink as you plan to on the night. EMOM stays at 3s: no crisp EMOM week owned yet. Five days after Tuesday's extras (Josh). No running.
